layouts.description: Draft configuration: Full rallycross perimeter uses the longer mapped northern branch and southern loop identified in the catalogue picture. Event regulations describe laps of 986 m and 978 m, consistent with the independently mapped 974.4 m draft rather than the catalogue scalar 1,440 m. Normal and joker branch classification remains provisional; no detour or repeated lap is added to reach the catalogue distance. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 974.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
